title: CWE-bench: Refocusing Agentic Security from Exploitation to Defense
abstract: arXiv:2610.17020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cybersecurity evaluations of AI agents have focused largely on offense, yet a working exploit does not show that an agent can make software safe. An attacker needs to exploit only one vulnerability; a defender must find and fix all of them. We introduce CWE-bench, a private benchmark of 120 held-out repository audit-and-repair tasks spanning 73 CWE types, eight languages, and all OWASP Top 10 2025 categories. Agents are given a repository to audit and a description of its threat model, but are not told the weakness, where it occurs, or how many vulnerable sites there are. Each patch must block the exploit while preserving original functionality, as checked by a programmatic verifier. We validated the verifier against a panel of agentic judges, manually reviewing disagreements during development and refining the checks. The best agents reach 68% pass@1 and 81% pass@4. translated_title: CWE-bench：将智能体安全研究的重心从漏洞利用转向防御
translated_abstract: 对AI智能体的网络安全评估大多集中在攻击方面，然而一个可用的漏洞利用并不能证明智能体能够使软件变得安全。攻击者只需利用一个漏洞即可；而防御者必须找到并修复所有漏洞。我们推出了CWE-bench，这是一个包含120个独立保留的仓库审计与修复任务的私有基准，涵盖73种CWE类型、八种编程语言以及OWASP Top 10 2025的所有类别。智能体被给予一个待审计的仓库及其威胁模型的描述，但不会被告知弱点是什么、出现在哪里，或存在多少个易受攻击的位置。每个补丁必须在保持原有功能的前提下阻止漏洞利用，这由程序化验证器进行检查。我们通过与一组智能体评判者的对比验证了该验证器，并在开发过程中人工审查分歧、不断改进检查规则。表现最佳的智能体达到68%的pass@1和81%的pass@4。我们进一步进行的分析表明：(i) 具有相同通过……
tldr: 提出CWE-bench私有基准，通过120个涵盖73种CWE类型的仓库审计与修复任务，将AI智能体安全评估从攻击转向防御，要求补丁在保留功能的同时阻断所有漏洞利用，最佳智能体达到68% pass@1。
en_tdlr: CWE-bench introduces a private benchmark of 120 repository audit-and-repair tasks spanning 73 CWE types, shifting agentic security evaluation from exploitation to defense, where patches must block exploits while preserving functionality, with the best agents achieving 68% pass@1.
